changelog: Say "fix it" or "proofread this" — or "ঠিক করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole dictated message is proofread in one pass through Smart Refine (Gemini) with your own key. Gboard's Pixel 9+ "Fix it" command, now on this keyboard in English and Bengali — the fix for a message dictated with the live AI-refine toggle off, or one that needs a second look as a whole.
